description: Defines the 'unit' class and related functions for managing game units in the Battle for Wesnoth project, including unit properties, behaviors, and interactions.

classes.name: unit
classes.description: Represents a game unit with properties, state, and behaviors such as movement, attack, and status effects.

classes.name: team_data
classes.description: Holds aggregated data about a team, including unit count, upkeep, villages, expenses, income, and gold.

classes.name: temporary_unit_placer
classes.description: A helper class to temporarily place a unit in the unit map, restoring previous state upon destruction.

methods.name: team_units
methods.description: Counts the number of units belonging to a specific team.

methods.name: team_upkeep
methods.description: Calculates the total upkeep cost for a team's units.

methods.name: team_leader
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the leader unit of a team.

methods.name: team_name
methods.description: Returns the name of a team.

methods.name: find_visible_unit
methods.description: Finds a visible unit at a location within the map, considering lawful bonus and teams.

methods.name: calculate_team_data
methods.description: Calculates aggregated data for a team.

methods.name: vacant_villages
methods.description: Returns a set of village locations that are vacant.

methods.name: temporary_unit_placer
methods.description: Constructs an object to temporarily place a unit in the unit map.
